Senior Backend Engineer

Northwind Technologies

Northwind Technologies is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Platform team. You will design and operate distributed systems that process millions of events per day, working closely with product and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable, scalable services.

Requirements

5+ years of backend experience, strong Python or Go skills, and hands-on experience operating services on Kubernetes in production. Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, availability, and failure handling.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with event-driven architectures, PostgreSQL at scale, and mentoring junior engineers. Prior experience in a fast-paced startup environment is a plus, as is familiarity with observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana.

What We Offer

We offer competitive compensation, remote-friendly work, and a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Our team values thoughtful code review and sustainable on-call practices.
